threat_event: Bulk export of associate and candidate PII through a compromised recruiter or payroll account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiter and payroll roles can export large result sets; SaaS exports not covered by egress alerts
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (recruiter and payroll export rights); EV-015 (no SaaS bulk export rule)
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.15
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; export alerts in the payroll engine
treatment_plan: Export limits per role; SaaS export alerts; session token protection

threat_event: Fraudulent direct deposit changes divert associate pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS code approves bank changes; 690 diversions in 2025 (about $1.9 million)
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (SMS code approves bank changes); EV-033 (690 diversions, about $1.9 million, in 2025)
existing_controls: Email notice of bank change; repayment of diverted pay
treatment_plan: Passkey or app authenticator; 3-day hold and out-of-band confirmation on first-time changes

threat_event: AI ranking add-on screens out protected groups at higher rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-advance on for Commercial requisitions; adverse impact monitored only for NYC requisitions
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (auto-advance on Commercial requisitions); EV-038 (audit covers NYC requisitions only)
regulatory_driver: Title VII 703(k); ADA 42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6); N56-R08 (NYC Admin. Code 20-870 et seq.)
existing_controls: Recruiter review of ranked lists; annual NYC bias audit
treatment_plan: Group-wide adverse impact monitoring by requisition family; turn off auto-advance; candidate notices (P10)

threat_event: Departed or shared E-Verify accounts are used to create or view cases
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: E-Verify outside SSO; not on the termination checklist in all centers
likelihood_basis: EV-047 (E-Verify outside SSO; removal on the checklist at 5 of 9 centers)
treatment_plan: Termination checklist; monthly HR reconciliation

threat_event: Payroll engine outage before Friday pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Repeat-payroll procedure not exercised
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (repeat-payroll procedure not exercised)
treatment_plan: Exercise the repeat-payroll procedure each quarter

threat_event: Attacker uses an unsegmented lobby kiosk to reach branch staff devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks on the staff network at 61 legacy branches
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (kiosks on the staff network at 61 legacy branches)
treatment_plan: Segment the 61 branches by 2027-03-31

threat_event: Scanned I-9 archive viewed or altered without a record, so integrity cannot be shown at inspection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Object-level access logging off for the 2009-2016 archive
likelihood_basis: EV-034 (object-level access logging off)
treatment_plan: Turn on object-level logging; retention-based purge of forms past 274a.2(b)(2) dates

threat_event: Consumer report copies kept and disposed of without evidence of secure disposal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No deletion schedule for consumer reports in onboarding
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (consumer reports kept with no deletion setting); EV-044 (no deletion job)
treatment_plan: Automated deletion of consumer reports by schedule

threat_event: Conversational recruiting assistant screens out candidates with knockout questions without review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knockout questions added by branches without review; no audit of outcomes
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (branch knockout questions outside the library); EV-075 (Staffing risk interviews)
existing_controls: Central question library for most requisitions
treatment_plan: Lock the question library; legal review of every knockout question; monthly outcome audit

threat_event: Client VMS integration credentials are abused to pull worker data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 400 client VMS integrations use shared service accounts and long-lived keys
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (about 400 integrations with shared accounts and long-lived keys)
treatment_plan: Rotate keys; per-client service identities

threat_event: Time capture outage misses the Monday payroll cutoff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single timekeeping vendor; clock buffers 72 hours
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (single timekeeping vendor; 72-hour buffer)
treatment_plan: Documented cutoff extension and estimated pay procedure

threat_event: A clinician with a forged or lapsed license is placed at a hospital
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credential checks rely on uploaded documents for some states without primary-source automation
likelihood_basis: EV-075 (credential checks by uploaded documents in some states)
treatment_plan: Primary-source automation for all license types

threat_event: Clinician medical screening files are viewed by recruiters
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credentialing roles restrict medical files; regional exceptions exist
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (medical file roles); EV-086 (regional exceptions for 2 managers)
treatment_plan: Remove regional exceptions

threat_event: VMS tenant misconfiguration exposes one client's program data to another client or supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual configuration of client programs in a shared tenant
likelihood_basis: EV-053 (manual configuration of one shared tenant)
treatment_plan: Peer review and automated tests for program setup

threat_event: Supplier invoice fraud in MSP programs goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VMS tenant audit logs not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-053 (tenant audit logs exported; no review record)
treatment_plan: Monthly audit log review and rate-change alerts

threat_event: Caller impersonates an associate and changes a bank account by phone
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based checks only
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (knowledge-based checks before bank changes)
existing_controls: Call scripts; supervisor review of repeat callers
treatment_plan: One-time code to the registered app before phone changes

threat_event: Recruiter account takeover posts fake jobs and phishes candidates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters are high-volume phishing targets
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (phishing exercises); EV-075 (recruiters as phishing targets)
treatment_plan: Token theft detection; job posting approval for new postings

threat_event: Old candidate and associate records enlarge breach scope and privacy request load
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7.2 million candidate profiles since 2014
likelihood_basis: EV-029 (7.2 million candidate profiles since 2014); EV-044 (no deletion job)
regulatory_driver: N56-BM (PR.DS-01); CCPA (Cal. Civ. Code 1798.100 et seq.)
treatment_plan: Purge candidates inactive over 4 years except where law requires longer

threat_event: VMS vendor outage stops all 48 MSP programs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single VMS vendor
likelihood_basis: EV-053 (single VMS vendor); EV-040 (VMS vendor SOC 2 report)
treatment_plan: Manual program procedures; vendor exit plan

threat_event: Loss of a recruiter laptop or phone with cached candidate data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile devices in branches and field
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (encryption and remote wipe); EV-075 (device loss accounts)
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes exposure unlikely

threat_event: Paper Forms I-9 and identity document copies at branches are lost or improperly discarded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some branches still take paper forms during outages
likelihood_basis: EV-075 (paper forms at some branches during outages)
treatment_plan: Scan within 3 days and shred; branch audits

threat_event: Associate PII sent to clients in spreadsheets (submittals with SSNs or dates of birth)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some clients ask for SSNs for site badges
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (clients ask for SSNs for badges); EV-054 (DLP in monitor mode)
existing_controls: Email data loss prevention in monitor mode
treatment_plan: Block SSN patterns in outbound email; client portal for badge data

threat_event: NYC requisitions use the AI ranking tool without a current bias audit summary or notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Requisitions for NYC jobs created outside NYC branches miss the notice step
likelihood_basis: EV-075 (NYC requisitions created outside NYC branches); EV-087 (notice missing on those jobs)
existing_controls: Annual bias audit; notice on NYC career pages
treatment_plan: Location-based notice rule in the ATS

threat_event: California worker and applicant privacy requests are missed or late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Requests arrive at branches and are not logged centrally
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (requests arrive at branches and by web form)
treatment_plan: Central request tracking

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Florida onboarding and payroll center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Largest center in Florida
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (largest center in Florida); EV-070 (cross-training and remote work)
existing_controls: Second center in another state; remote work
treatment_plan: Annual failover drill between centers

threat_event: A departing recruiter downloads candidate lists before joining a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters can export their pipelines
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (recruiters can export their pipelines)
treatment_plan: Export alerts for users with resignation flags
